name: @bust/eslint-config
description: Shared ESLint configuration for Busticated JS/TS projects
author: Busticated

scripts.version: npm run changelog:update && npm run docs:build
scripts.test:unit: npm run build && node --test --test-reporter spec --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-lines=99 --test-coverage-branches=100 --test-coverage-functions=100 --enable-source-maps dist/esm/*.test.js
scripts.test:e2e: echo "Zero e2e tests to run!" && exit 0
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:build:api && npm run docs:build:readme
scripts.docs:build:api: typedoc --plugin typedoc-plugin-markdown --hideBreadcrumbs true --githubPages false --sourceLinkTemplate '/{path}#L{line}' --readme none src/index.ts
